tool_schemas.name: get_user
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single Intruder user by user_id and returns the user record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if user_id does not match the required intr_usr_… format, NOT_FOUND if no such user exists in your account, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if your API key is missing, invalid, or not permitted to access that user.

user_id.description: The Intruder user ID to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: get_status
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current service status for the Intruder API. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if your API key is missing or invalid (when authentication is required for the status check) and SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE if the API cannot serve the request.

tool_schemas.name: list_targets
tool_schemas.description: Lists targets (assets) in your Intruder account and returns a paged result set of target records, including each target’s ID and status; results are ordered by sort and order, and pagination uses limit with a cursor returned for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter values (including unsupported status/sort/order or out-of-range limit) and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the API key cannot access the account’s inventory.

target_addresses.description: Filter targets by a list of target addresses (exact match).

tag_names.description: Filter targets by a list of tag names applied to the targets.

limit.description: Maximum number of targets to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: list_issues
tool_schemas.description: Lists issues in your Intruder account and returns a paged result set of issue records, optionally filtered by target addresses, tag names, snoozed state, and severity; results are ordered by sort and order, and pagination uses limit with a cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter values (including unsupported severity/sort/order or out-of-range limit) and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the API key is missing, invalid, or lacks access to issues for the account.

target_addresses.description: Filter issues to those affecting any of the given target addresses.

tag_names.description: Filter issues to those affecting targets with any of the given tag names.

snoozed.description: Filter issues by whether they are snoozed.

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: list_scans
tool_schemas.description: Lists scans in your Intruder account and returns a paged result set of scan records, optionally filtered by status, scan_type, target addresses, and tag names; results are ordered by sort and order, and pagination uses limit with a cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter values (including unsupported status/scan_type/sort/order or out-of-range limit) and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the API key cannot access scan history for the account.

target_addresses.description: Filter scans to those requested against any of the given target addresses.

tag_names.description: Filter scans to those requested against any of the given tag names.

limit.description: Maximum number of scans to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: list_tags
tool_schemas.description: Lists tags in your Intruder account and returns a paged result set of tag records, optionally filtered to tags applied to any of the provided target addresses; results are ordered by sort and order, and pagination uses limit with a cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter values (including unsupported sort/order or out-of-range limit) and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the API key cannot access tags for the account.

target_address.description: Filter tags to those applied to the given target addresses.

limit.description: Maximum number of tags to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: list_occurrences
tool_schemas.description: Lists occurrences (per-target findings) for a specific issue_id and returns a paged result set of occurrence records, optionally filtered by target addresses, tag names, snoozed state, and occurrence_status; results are ordered by sort and order, and pagination uses limit with a cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid issue_id format or invalid filters (including unsupported occurrence_status/sort/order or out-of-range limit), NOT_FOUND if the issue_id does not exist or is not visible in your account, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the API key cannot access occurrences.

issue_id.description: The ID of the issue to list occurrences for.

target_addresses.description: Filter occurrences by a list of target addresses.

tag_names.description: Filter occurrences by a list of tag names.

snoozed.description: Filter occurrences by whether they are snoozed.

limit.description: Maximum number of occurrences to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_scanner_output
tool_schemas.description: Returns the scanner output for a specific occurrence_id of an issue_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if issue_id or occurrence_id are not in the required intr_iss_… / intr_occ_… formats, NOT_FOUND if the issue or occurrence does not exist (or the occurrence is not associated with the issue), and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the API key cannot access the underlying finding.

tool_schemas.name: create_scan
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new scan request for the union of explicitly provided target_addresses and all targets matching the provided tag_names, and returns the created scan record (including its scan ID and initial status). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither target_addresses nor tag_names are provided, if any provided values are invalid, or if the request cannot be resolved to any valid targets; raises CONFLICT if a scan cannot be started due to account/state restrictions, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the API key is not permitted to initiate scans.

target_addresses.description: List of target addresses to include in the scan.

tag_names.description: List of tag names; all targets with these tags will be included in the scan.

tool_schemas.name: get_scan
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single scan by scan_id and returns the scan record including status and timing fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if scan_id does not match the required intr_scn_… format, NOT_FOUND if the scan does not exist or is not visible in your account, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the API key cannot access the scan.

scan_id.description: The ID of the scan to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_scan
tool_schemas.description: Cancels the scan identified by scan_id and returns the updated scan record reflecting the cancellation request. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if scan_id does not match the required format, NOT_FOUND if the scan does not exist or is not accessible to your account, and CONFLICT if the scan is not in a cancellable state (for example, already completed, failed, or previously cancelled). Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to manage scans for the owning account.

scan_id.description: The ID of the scan to cancel.

tool_schemas.name: delete_target
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the target identified by target_id from your inventory and returns confirmation of deletion. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if target_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the target does not exist or is not accessible to your account, and CONFLICT if the target cannot be deleted due to an unsupported state transition (for example, when deletion is disallowed while it is in use). Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to delete targets for the owning account.

target_id.description: The ID of the target to delete.

tool_schemas.name: create_targets
tool_schemas.description: Creates one target per provided address and returns the created target records. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if addresses is empty or any address value is invalid, and CONFLICT if a target for a given address already exists in your inventory. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to create targets for the account.

addresses.description: List of target addresses to create.

tool_schemas.name: create_target_tag
tool_schemas.description: Adds the tag name to the target identified by target_id and returns the updated target (including its tags). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if target_id is malformed or name exceeds 40 characters, NOT_FOUND if the target does not exist or is not accessible to your account, and CONFLICT if the tag is already present on the target. Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to modify the target.

target_id.description: The ID of the target to add the tag to.

name.description: The tag name to add (max 40 characters).

tool_schemas.name: delete_target_tag
tool_schemas.description: Removes tag_name from the target identified by target_id and returns the updated target (including its remaining tags). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if target_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the target does not exist or is not accessible to your account, and NOT_FOUND if the specified tag is not present on that target. Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to modify the target.

target_id.description: The ID of the target to remove the tag from.

tag_name.description: The name of the tag to remove from the target.

tool_schemas.name: list_licenses
tool_schemas.description: List license information for the Intruder account. Shows usage and limits for infrastructure and application licenses. When a license is used, it is tied to the target that used it for 30 days.

limit.description: Maximum number of license records to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: snooze_issue
tool_schemas.description: Applies a snooze to the issue identified by issue_id so that the issue and all of its current and future occurrences are treated as snoozed, returning the updated issue (including its snooze metadata). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if issue_id is malformed, reason is not one of ACCEPT_RISK/FALSE_POSITIVE/MITIGATING_CONTROLS, or duration is provided but is less than 1, and NOT_FOUND if the issue does not exist or is not accessible to your account. Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to triage issues for the owning account, and CONFLICT if the issue cannot be snoozed due to an unsupported state transition.

issue_id.description: The ID of the issue to snooze.

details.description: Optional free-text details to justify or explain the snooze.

duration_type.description: Optional duration type label (e.g., 'days' or 'hours') stored with the snooze.

tool_schemas.name: snooze_occurrence
tool_schemas.description: Applies a snooze to the specific occurrence identified by occurrence_id under the issue identified by issue_id, returning the updated occurrence (including its snooze metadata). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if either ID is malformed, reason is not one of ACCEPT_RISK/FALSE_POSITIVE/MITIGATING_CONTROLS, or duration is provided but is less than 1, NOT_FOUND if the issue or occurrence does not exist or is not accessible to your account, and CONFLICT if the occurrence does not belong to the given issue_id. Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to triage findings for the owning account, and CONFLICT if the occurrence cannot be snoozed due to an unsupported state transition.

issue_id.description: The ID of the issue the occurrence belongs to.

occurrence_id.description: The ID of the occurrence to snooze.

details.description: Optional free-text details to justify or explain the snooze.

duration_type.description: Optional duration type label (e.g., 'days' or 'hours') stored with the snooze.

metadata.name: Intruder
